1804 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not a century year).  
From 02-21 back 21 days → Feb 1.  
Remaining 145 − 21 = 124 days earlier.  
Jan has 31 days, so back 31 days → Dec 2, 1803.  
Remaining 124 − 31 = 93 days earlier.  
Dec 1803 back 93 days:  
Dec 1 back 1 day → Nov 30, back 30 more days → Nov 1.  
Remaining 93 − 31 = 62 days earlier.  
Oct has 31 days → back 31 days → Oct 1.  
Remaining 62 − 31 = 31 days earlier.  
Sep has 30 days → back 30 days → Sep 2.  
Remaining 31 − 30 = 1 day earlier → Sep 1, 1803.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1803-09-01
